text:
ITEM 1 | Mixed leafy greens, mostly crisp dark green and pale green romaine-like leaves with some lighter inner leaves, slightly glossy and moist, piled loosely in a mound about 10 cm across and 3 cm tall, with a few dark purplish-brown leaf bits and a small cluster of dark olive-like pieces on the left side | 85
ITEM 2 | Single small red tomato pieces (about 1.5 cm across) with glossy red skin tucked among the greens near the top center, slightly juicy | 12
ITEM 3 | Rectangular slice of baked pizza-like item about 5 cm by 4 cm and 1.5 cm thick, pale golden crust edge with browned spots, covered in red tomato sauce and melted pale cheese, slightly oily sheen, sits beside the greens at the lower right of the mound | 55
